Page 1131 
Lumvoa (veligrotug-vvze) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-707203  
Guideline Name 
Lumvoa (veligrotug-vvze)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
9/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Lumvoa  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of moderate-
to-severe thyroid eye disease (TED), confirmed by both of the following:  
• 
Clinical Activity Score (CAS) ≥ 4  
• 
Orbital imaging (CT or MRI) confirming extraocular muscle or orbital fat involvement  


--- PDF page 1132 ---
Page 1132 
 
AND 
 
2 - Trial and failure (minimum of 12 weeks), contraindication, or intolerance to at least 4.5 g IV 
glucocorticoid therapy (e.g., IV methylprednisolone)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Endocrinologist  
• 
Specialist with expertise in the treatment of TED  
• 
Ophthalmologist  
 
AND 
 
4 - Treatment with Lumvoa has not exceeded a total of 5 infusions over 12 week course  
 
AND 
 
5 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with Tepezza (teprotumumab)  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes  
8/26/2026  
New Program
